description: This file defines an OAuthClientsController class in a NestJS application, handling CRUD operations for OAuth clients, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting OAuth client records. It also includes endpoints for fetching managed users related to OAuth clients. The controller uses various decorators for routing, authorization, and API documentation.

classes.name: OAuthClientsController
classes.description: Controller class managing OAuth client operations such as create, retrieve, update, delete, and fetching managed users, with route and authorization decorators.

methods.name: createOAuthClient
methods.description: Creates a new OAuth client after verifying team subscription status.

methods.name: getOAuthClients
methods.description: Retrieves all OAuth clients for an organization.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: getOAuthClientManagedUsersById
methods.description: Fetches users managed by a specific OAuth client (endpoint excluded from API documentation).

methods.name: updateOAuthClient
methods.description: Updates an existing OAuth client by ID.

methods.name: deleteOAuthClient
methods.description: Deletes an OAuth client by ID.
